red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：胸痛可能是心梗、肺栓塞、主动脉夹层等急危重症表现，请立即拨打急救电话或前往最近的急诊科！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Chest pain may indicate myocardial infarction, pulmonary embolism, or aortic dissection. Call emergency services immediately!
red_flags.source: AHA/ACC 2023 Guideline for Management of Patients With STEMI

red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：疑似脑卒中（中风）！请立即就医，记住 FAST 原则：Face（面瘫）、Arm（肢体无力）、Speech（言语不清）、Time（抓紧时间）！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Suspected stroke (brain attack)! Seek immediate medical attention. Remember FAST: Face, Arm, Speech, Time!
red_flags.source: American Stroke Association 2021 Guideline for the Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke

red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：疑似脊髓压迫（如肿瘤、脓肿、椎间盘突出），请立即就医，延误可能导致永久性瘫痪！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Suspected spinal cord compression. Seek immediate medical attention to prevent permanent paralysis!

red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：疑似急性心力衰竭、肺栓塞或重症哮喘，请立即就医！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Suspected acute heart failure, pulmonary embolism, or severe asthma. Seek immediate medical attention!
red_flags.source: ESC 2024 Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure

red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：疑似颅内出血、脑膜炎或颅内压增高，请立即就医！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Suspected intracranial hemorrhage, meningitis, or increased intracranial pressure. Seek immediate medical attention!

symptom_keywords_zh: 受伤后立即出现功能障碍
symptom_keywords_en: inability to bear weight after fall
red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 警告：可能存在骨折或韧带完全断裂，请尽快就医进行影像学检查！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ WARNING: Possible fracture or complete ligament rupture. Seek medical attention promptly for imaging.
red_flags.source: AAOS 2023 Clinical Practice Guideline for Management of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries

red_flags.warning_zh: ⚠️ 红旗警告：生命体征不稳定，可能存在休克、严重感染或肺栓塞，请立即就医！
red_flags.warning_en: ⚠️ RED FLAG: Unstable vital signs. Possible shock, severe infection, or pulmonary embolism. Seek immediate medical attention!
